reviews.review: I bought Redfall on sale, it's version 4 and I guess the game has been greatly improved since its release. There's a great deal of freedom of movement: the character can pull himself up from a great height, climb through windows, etc. He can use the environment to fight by blowing up cars, for example. The AI has been corrected. There are still some glitches and in 3 hours, the game crashed once. Nowhere near as good as Dishonored but it's not a bad open-world FPS. Only buy on sale if you like killing vampires.

The game at full price is not worth the money, there were so many things i wanted to like about this game, the potential was there, i still think there is, but unfortunately the studio that made the game is gone, so any potential for it to be made better is out the dang window. by the end of the first half, i found myself trying to just push through, as i was pretty bored with the story and the game mechanics, once i got to the second half and got maybe two or three map way-points, i had life for this game sucked outta me. 

i love the idea of going after vampires and cultists instead of zombies, but to me if the game goes on sale for less than twenty bucks id say sure go for it, give it a try if you wanna try something thats zombie equivalent without the zombies...

wish i could add more detail of specifically what i dont like about the game, but i played this a couple months ago and my memory is a little hazy on it, and i mainly remember wishing i could fall in love with the game and wishing there was simply more to the game.
It was a fun game. did a lot of grinding.

Had fun playing the game. I did not pay full price however. i only paid 15 during a sale. For 15 Bucks, this game is sweet. Running around slaying vampires and cultists alike. I like getting the collectibles and all that so even completing it was not too bad. If you see the game on sale and like vampire hunting and an intriguing story, give the game a shot. yes it has its issues but i still enjoyed my time at Redfall
